layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) - Asymmetric. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 for heroes, col-span-4 for supporting content.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing: p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 for sections to give breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-[1800px] mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 xl:px-12
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Never center by default. Use strong left or right alignments, creating tension.

components_and_surfaces.cards: Brutalist. Flat background (bg-[#121212]), sharp 1px solid border (border-[#262626]), rounded-none. No drop shadows. Hover: -translate-y-1, border-[#ff4500].
components_and_surfaces.buttons: Industrial aesthetic. Sharp corners, primary bg or transparent with 1px border. Hover: invert colors or slide-up text animation.
components_and_surfaces.navigation: Sticky header (z-50) with glassmorphism (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl) or solid black with bottom border. Logo left, massive links, NO hamburger menu on desktop.
components_and_surfaces.marquee: Kinetic Texture style using react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text (text-8xl+) running in the background for high-energy sections like 'CRAFTED WITH PRECISION'.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion: fade-up and slight scale-in for images, staggered text-reveal for massive headings.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform for subtle parallax on hero backgrounds.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images convert from grayscale/low-contrast to full color/high-contrast on hover.

hero_background.description: Welding sparks illuminate the darkness, used as a cinematic textured background for the hero. Keep overlay dark (bg-black/60) to let text pop.

maker_process.description: CNC Machine cutting metal with sparks. Use in the Maker Showcase or 'Crafted with Precision' section.

maker_portrait.description: Maker standing in cluttered industrial workshop. Use for the 'For Makers' callout.

product_wood_sign.description: Custom wood carved wall sign. Use in product showcase.

product_metal_sign.description: Modern metal wall art sign. Use in product showcase.

cnc_closeup.description: Close-up of plasma cutting machine. Use in 'Browse by Category' or Process section.

texture_overlay.description: Grain/Texture background pattern. Use as a low-opacity overlay (mix-blend-overlay or opacity-10) on solid dark sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the Google Fonts for Anton and JetBrains Mono in index.html or global CSS.
Create a cinematic Hero Section: Full height, massive 'Anton' typography (text-6xl md:text-8xl+), raw steel/welding spark background with a heavy dark overlay.
Implement an Asymmetric Maker Showcase: Break out of generic flex/grid wrappers. Use overlapping elements (e.g., negative margins) and absolute positioning for Maker tags (Plasma, Laser, Router).
'For Makers' Callout: Design this like an editorial poster. One large image of a maker taking up 60% width, strong typography taking up 40%.
Browse by Category (Wall Art, Custom Signs, Outdoor Art): Use massive numbered editorial blocks (01, 02, 03) that expand or shift on hover. No standard uniform cards.
Process Section ('Crafted with Precision'): Use a kinetic marquee text in the background (text-9xl text-transparent outline text). Stagger the CAD -> CNC -> Finish steps.
Use data-testid on all buttons and actionable elements.
CRITICAL: Do not use 'Inter' font. Use 'Anton' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for body/labels/tags.
CRITICAL: No generic purple/teal gradients. Stick to the raw #0a0a0a, #e5e5e5, and #ff4500 (safety orange/plasma spark) palette.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' components if they force rounded borders. Build custom raw HTML/Tailwind divs with sharp borders for the industrial brutalist feel.
